pitchTracker.note: Point at the CURRENT QUARTER's Evolv Pitch Tracker sheet (e.g. 'Q3-26 Evolv Pitch Tracker'). New spreadsheet each quarter — update sheetId by hand until there's a reason to automate it.

whitelisting.note: 'Influencer Video Ad Tracker' tab inside the 'Shared_Evolv Paid Media & Whitelisting' spreadsheet. Header is split into METS/TikTok column-groups, not a flat header row — see api/pipeline-sync.js parseWhitelistingSheet.

resultsTracker.note: Evolv Paid Media Results Tracker — weekly account-level rows (Week Start, Week End, Influencer Orders, Total Orders, Influencer % of Orders, Influencer CPA, Overall CPA).
